cases.reason: The goal specifies an Export CSV button on the Thimblevane admin Orders page, the details define the four columns and date-filter behavior, and the criteria let a reviewer verify the button placement and downloaded rows.
The contract specifies a 30-minute expiry for password reset links sent by the Quillmoor members site and gives checkable outcomes for links opened within 30 minutes and at 31 minutes.
The task specifies a print stylesheet for Larkspur Kitchen’s recipe pages, names what to keep and hide, and gives a checkable result in the one-page A4 PDF of the Barley Soup recipe.
The contract names the script and log destination, specifies the fields the operator needs, and gives checkable criteria for a successful backup and an archive write failure.

The contract specifies where to show the event’s time zone in Hollowbrook’s guest invitations and gives checkable examples of the abbreviations that must follow the start time for Berlin and New York events.
The goal specifies what to show on Driftwood’s help centre search results page when no articles match, and the zzqqxx test checks the message, contact form link, and search box position.

The contract names the public forecast API and both headers to add for callers, and a reviewer can check that GET /v1/forecast reports the 600-call hourly limit and one fewer remaining call on the next request.
The task specifies where the first-day guide belongs, who it is for, and what it must cover, and a reviewer can check the file, its contents, and its one-page print length.
The goal identifies the exact heading change on the Thimblevane shop’s About page, and a reviewer can verify that the heading reads “Our story.”

The task specifies raising the Quillmoor members site’s idle sign-out time from 15 to 60 minutes for members reading long articles and gives a checkable criterion that a member stays signed in after 45 minutes of inactivity.
The goal identifies the map image on the Larkspur Kitchen blog’s Contact page and its screen reader audience, and the first criterion lets a reviewer verify the exact alt text.
The goal identifies the Hollowbrook RSVP form and the button guests use, and the build criterion lets a reviewer verify that the button reads “Send my reply.”
The contract names the Driftwood help centre but specifies neither a concrete change to make nor an observable outcome for the reviewer to check.
The contract identifies the Thimblevane shop but leaves the outdated items unspecified and gives the reviewer no concrete condition to verify.
The contract identifies the app and its report users and gives a checkable criterion, but the goal leaves open what should be made or changed.
The contract leaves the requested changes to the Quillmoor members site's sign-up flow undefined, so several different changes could satisfy the same check that new members can still sign up.
The goal identifies the home page and the photo to enlarge, but none of the acceptance criteria defines a concrete outcome a reviewer can verify.
The task identifies the Orders page and the staff who use it, but none of the criteria gives a reviewer a concrete way to verify that the page loads faster.
None of the acceptance criteria names a concrete change to the Hollowbrook RSVP form’s error messages that a reviewer can verify.
None of the acceptance criteria names a specific feature or outcome of the sign-up box that a reviewer can verify.
The goal leaves the changes to the Fernhollow weather app unspecified, and neither criterion gives a reviewer a concrete outcome to verify.
The contract names Tallowmere but leaves the intended code changes unspecified, and neither criterion identifies a concrete result a reviewer can verify.
The goal leaves the intended work on the Quillmoor members site undefined, and the acceptance criteria give a reviewer no specific behavior or result to verify.
The contract leaves the monthly changes to the Thimblevane shop unspecified and gives the reviewer no observable criterion for completion.
